name: Motherhood Oracle Mystery
body:
Note: If you are using the Oracle class in your games, you can use this mystery as written. If you are instead (or also) using the priest core class, you can use these revelations to replace the standard priestess abilities gained at 2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th, and 10th level.

You put family first and yourself second, providing food, shelter, protection, and comfort to those in your care.

Class Skills: An oracle with the motherhood mystery adds Knowledge (Local), Knowledge (Nature), Linguistics, and Perception to her list of class skills.

Bonus Spells: sanctuary (2nd), aid (4th), tiny hut (6th), bountiful banquet (8th), breath of life (10th), blade barrier (12th), liveoak (14th), divine vessel (16th), resplendent mansion (18th)

Revelations: An oracle with the motherhood mystery can choose from any of the following revelations.

Ever Vigilant (Su)

At the dawn of each day, you can touch a number of creatures equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. For the next 24 hours, the subjects of your touch are under the influence of the status spell.

Fear Not (Ex)

You gain a +1 morale bonus on saving throws against fear and fear effects. This bonus increases by +1 for every 5 oracle levels you possess, to a maximum of +5 at 20th level.

Additionally, when an ally within 60 feet of you is forced to make a saving throw roll against fear, you can use an immediate action to grant the ally a circumstance bonus equal to your Charisma modifier on the roll.

Helping Hand (Ex)

You can use the aid another action as an immediate action and the bonuses received by your ally are doubled. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Hopes and Dreams (Sp)

You add bless to your list of spells known. This does not count against your limit of spells known. At 7th level, you add good hope as well.

Mother’s Touch (Su)

You can heal certain ailments when you cast a spell with the word “cure” in it. At the dawn of every day, you can select two paladin mercies of 6th level or lower.

Until the dawn of the following day, you can apply either one of the selected mercies to a “cure” spell that you cast. You can apply your mercies a number of times per day equal to your oracle caster level. You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Nourished by Love (Su)

You no longer need food or water to survive. You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.

Pep Talk (Ex)

Whenever you cast a spell that grants a morale bonus to allies, the bonus increases by +1.

Pillar of Strength (Su)

As a standard action, you call upon your deity to fortify you with the strength to persevere in challenging times. Your deity envelopes you in an invisible protective shell, granting you a +1 deflection bonus to your armor class. At 7th level, and every four levels thereafter, this bonus increases by +1. While this revelation is active, your Strength is treated as though it is 4 points higher for the purpose of determining your carrying capacity and CMD.

Your deity can protect you for 1 hour per day per oracle level you possess. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-hour increments.

Self Sacrifice (Su)

When an ally within 60 feet of you has been hit by an attack, but before the damage is rolled, you can use an immediate action to swap places with the ally. You are instantly teleported to their space and they are teleported to yours. You then become the target of the damage to be rolled. If the ally does not wish to be teleported in this manner, your attempt automatically fails, but it still counts as one use of this ability. You can use this ability 3 times per day. You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Watchful Eye (Ex)

You gain Skill Focus (Perception) as a bonus feat.

Final Revelation

Upon reaching 20th level, you become the embodiment of motherhood; you are steadfast to the end, protecting those in your charge at all costs. Your Wisdom score increases by +2 and you gain a 10-foot radius aura of nurturing. While an ally is within your aura, the ally gains a +1 sacred bonus to AC and saving throws.
